caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass pitcher centered on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher features a bulbous body that gently tapers near the top and bottom. It has a pronounced, curving handle attached to the left side, with a decorative curled design at the base of the handle. The rim of the pitcher is slightly flared, with subtle horizontal lines indicating thickness and form. The coloring of the pitcher is achieved through light and dark gray shading to suggest transparency, reflection, and the curved surfaces of the glass. The bottom of the pitcher shows circular lines and some white highlights, reinforcing the impression of clear glass. There are no additional objects or patterns within the composition.
title: Water Pitcher
